operation.name: seqsubsky
operation.description:
Same command as SUBSKY but for the sequence sequencename .

Dithering, required for low dynamic gradients, can be disabled with -nodither . Note that the -existing option is not available for sequence background removal, as the frames of a sequence are not necessarily always aligned.

The output sequence name starts with the prefix "bkg_" unless otherwise specified with -prefix= option. Only selected images in the sequence are processed

Links: subsky

Uses fixed input references and writes only invocation-owned outputs. Optional argument values are sent only when their use_* control is true; zero is preserved.

help:
Siril 1.4.4. Same command as SUBSKY but for the sequence sequencename .

Dithering, required for low dynamic gradients, can be disabled with -nodither . Note that the -existing option is not available for sequence background removal, as the frames of a sequence are not necessarily always aligned.

The output sequence name starts with the prefix "bkg_" unless otherwise specified with -prefix= option. Only selected images in the sequence are processed

Links: subsky

Uses fixed input references and writes only invocation-owned outputs. Optional argument values are sent only when their use_* control is true; zero is preserved.



runtime is a JSON object. Supported keys: ini, settings, threads, memory_ratio, output_bits, compression, online, selection, findstar, photometry. Networking starts offline and must be enabled explicitly. Selection is omitted for the whole image or explicitly null to clear it; optional CLI arguments use separate use_* controls. Connect transforms to an explicit export, stacking, or analysis endpoint. Only requested dependencies are executed; previews do not make other branches endpoints. Saved output references identify complete checked files, never preview pixels. See reference/coverage.json and docs/usage.md.
